$comment: Spec 135 per-server OAuth issuer status. Placement: (1) doctor / GET /api/v1/diagnostics: new object `oauth_issuer_status` beside the Spec 123 `oauth_token_storage` report, built by management from Runtime.OAuthIssuerStatus (live per-server state) — not inside the admin-only `warnings` of the storage report. (2) Each entry's warnings are ALSO appended to the per-server runtime warnings that diagnostics already emits (internal/management/diagnostics.go:327-334). (3) Scoped callers (agent tokens, pinned profiles) receive only servers in reach; counts are recomputed over that set. (4) An undecryptable row (Spec 123) reports binding_state=unknown and no issuer fields. The same per-server fields are added to the existing scoped server-list projection (GET /api/v1/servers, contracts.Server), which feeds `mcpproxy auth status --server=<name>`, Web UI ServerDetail and the macOS detail. Issuers are origins only.
